# pve_url_metadata (Data Source)

Metadata (filename, size, checksum) of a URL as retrieved by a node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_url_metadata" "example" {
node = "pve1"
url = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `url` (String) The URL to query the metadata from.

### Optional

- `verify_certificates` (Boolean) If false, no SSL/TLS certificates will be verified. (default: 1)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `metadata` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Read-Only:

- `filename` (String)
- `mimetype` (String)
- `size` (Number)
